description: Cherry-picks the unified binomial pattern from sibling PR #1125 (c_{2j}(T(2,2m)) = C(m+j, 2j)/2, sympy-proved) and evaluates the trace polynomial P_m(h_0) for W=T(2,4), Z=T(2,6), H=T(2,8). Reports cross-particle ratios + structural-limitation analysis. Honest follow-up to PR #1126's retraction of the W = √[2]_q substrate-point fit.
honest_limits: Trace polynomial values P_m(h_0) are in [0.5, 0.75] range; actual masses span [80, 125] GeV
Mass-to-trace ratio varies per particle (no clean single normalization)
W/Z 1% match is the best signal; Z/H and W/H both off ~20%
Cannot fix all 3 ratios with a single multiplicative/additive correction
Full SM derivation requires gauge couplings (g, g', λ) categorically
interpretation: The trace polynomial P_m(h_0) using PR #1125's binomial coefficients gives W/Z within 1% of SM cos θ_W — suggestive structural pattern. But Z/H and W/H deviations remain ~20%, showing the trace polynomial alone CANNOT predict all 3 SM ratios simultaneously. Structural conclusion: full SM mass spectrum derivation requires gauge-coupling chain (g, g', λ) currently absent from framework. The CategoricalHiggsIdempotent class (existing placeholder) is the structural target for this extension (per PR #1126 retraction audit §3).
what_is_kept: Sibling PR #1125's binomial pattern c_{2j} = C(m+j, 2j)/2 (sympy-proved)
PR #1116's foundational chain separation (hyperbolic vs torus)
RT-chain SM particle map W=T(2,4), Z=T(2,6), H=T(2,8) (existing content)
what_is_retracted: PR #1122's 'W = √[2]_q closes ratios to 7% (STRONG)' — substrate-point fit, jet-order shows 20% per jet
PR #1122's '√[2]_q is the quantum spinor norm' interpretation — it's the SM Higgs-VEV doublet convention
